feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 26 September 2026 4:32pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 26 September 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Flat ridge of high pressure will decline, developing Atlantic frontal system will move quickly across the area tomorrow.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 5 occasionally 6, backing South or Southeast later tonight, increasing 5 to 7 tomorrow morning, then veering West or Northwest 5 or 6 through tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, possibly moderate to rough in a few places for a time tomorrow.


##Weather##

Fair, then heavy rain moving northeastwards across the area for a time tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor at times in rain tomorrow.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Northwest 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 tomorrow evening, then West or Southwest 3 or 4 overnight into Monday. Backing South or Southeast through Monday morning and afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, falling slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
